items.source: This class is aware of Spring MVC handler mappings used to serve static resources and uses the ResourceResolver chains of the configured ResourceHttpRequestHandlers to make its decisions.
items.translation: 该类了解用于提供静态资源的 Spring MVC 处理器映射，并使用配置的`ResourceHttpRequestHandler`的`ResourceResolver`链来做出决策。

items.source: Note: by default resource mappings are auto-detected from the Spring ApplicationContext. However, if this property is used, the auto-detection is turned off.
items.translation: 注意： 默认情况下，资源映射会自动从 Spring ApplicationContext 中检测。但是，如果使用了此属性，则会自动关闭自动检测功能。

items.source:
It is expected that the given path is what Spring MVC would use for
request mapping purposes, i.e. excluding context and servlet path portions.
items.translation: 预期给定的路径是 Spring MVC 用于请求映射的路径，即不包含上下文路径和 Servlet 路径部分。

items.source:
If several handler mappings match, the handler used will be the one
configured with the most specific pattern.
items.translation: 如果有多个处理器映射匹配，将使用配置了最具体模式的处理器。

items.source: A variation on getForLookupPath(String) that accepts a full request URL path (i.e. including context and servlet path) and returns the full request URL path to expose for public use.
